description: Chibi armored soldier, round steel helmet with knob top, angry squinting eyes, pale blue wind-swirl scarf, silver pauldron over white tunic, brown belt and boots, holding tall crystalline wind spear with flowing ribbon and swirling air currents, round shield with spiral wind emblem, standing on grassy hill under bright blue sky, drifting leaves, soft painterly cel-shaded style, clean outlines, bold flat colors, gentle rim lighting.
